context.decision: Draw the boundary before the boxes.
context.why: Agreeing what is in and out of scope prevents most re-architecture later.
context.tradeoff: Some integrations deliberately pushed to v2.

nodes.label: API gateway
nodes.decision: Single gateway for auth, rate limits and routing.
nodes.why: Cross-cutting concerns live in one place, not in every service.
nodes.tradeoff: A critical hop — run it HA across zones.

nodes.label: Identity
nodes.decision: Short-lived JWTs, verified at the edge.
nodes.why: Services stay stateless; no session store on the hot path.
nodes.tradeoff: Revocation needs a deny-list with a short TTL.

nodes.label: Core service
nodes.decision: Modular monolith before microservices.
nodes.why: One deployable, clear module boundaries; extract only under real load.
nodes.tradeoff: Discipline needed to keep modules from coupling.

nodes.label: Event bus
nodes.decision: Publish domain events instead of calling downstream.
nodes.why: Writes stay fast; consumers scale and replay independently.
nodes.tradeoff: Eventual consistency — UI shows pending states.

nodes.label: Workers
nodes.decision: Idempotent consumers keyed by event id.
nodes.why: Safe retries and replays without double effects.
nodes.tradeoff: Every handler carries a dedupe check.

nodes.label: Primary DB
nodes.decision: Postgres as the system of record.
nodes.why: Transactions, constraints and mature tooling beat novelty.
nodes.tradeoff: Vertical limits — read replicas + partitioning planned.

nodes.label: Cache
nodes.decision: Read-through cache for hot entities only.
nodes.why: Cuts p99 on the top 5% of keys that get 80% of reads.
nodes.tradeoff: Invalidation on write via events.

nodes.label: Search
nodes.decision: Search index built from events, never written directly.
nodes.why: Rebuildable from the log at any time.
nodes.tradeoff: Index lags writes by seconds.

adrs.title: Event bus over synchronous fan-out
adrs.context: Order writes triggered five downstream calls; one slow dependency stalled checkout.
adrs.decision: Publish domain events to Kafka; consumers react asynchronously.
adrs.consequence: Eventual consistency, plus an outbox to guarantee delivery.

adrs.title: Modular monolith first
adrs.context: Small team, unclear seams, high change rate.
adrs.decision: One deployable with enforced module boundaries.
adrs.consequence: Extraction later is cheap because boundaries already exist.

adrs.title: SLO-based alerting
adrs.context: Threshold alerts paged on noise, missed real user pain.
adrs.decision: Alert on error-budget burn rate per user journey.

adrs.title: Infrastructure as code only
adrs.context: Console drift between staging and prod.
adrs.decision: Terraform modules, plan in CI, apply on merge.

context.decision: Draw the boundary before the boxes.
context.why: Agreeing what is in and out of scope prevents most re-architecture later.
context.tradeoff: Some integrations deliberately pushed to v2.

nodes.label: API / BFF
nodes.decision: Streaming responses over SSE.
nodes.why: Perceived latency drops to first token.
nodes.tradeoff: Harder retries mid-stream.

nodes.label: Orchestrator
nodes.decision: Explicit state graph, not a free-form agent loop.
nodes.why: Every step is inspectable, testable and bounded.
nodes.tradeoff: Less "magic"; more upfront design.

nodes.label: Model gateway
nodes.decision: Provider-agnostic gateway with fallback.
nodes.why: No single-vendor outage takes the product down.
nodes.tradeoff: Prompt behaviour differs per model — evals per provider.

nodes.label: Vector store
nodes.decision: pgvector inside Postgres before a dedicated vector DB.
nodes.why: One fewer system; joins with metadata for free.
nodes.tradeoff: Re-evaluate past ~50M vectors.

nodes.label: Ingestion
nodes.decision: Chunk + embed asynchronously, versioned.
nodes.why: Re-index without downtime when the embedding model changes.
nodes.tradeoff: Storage for two index versions during cut-over.

nodes.label: Evals & guardrails
nodes.decision: Every prompt change ships behind an eval gate.
nodes.why: Regressions are caught before users see them.
nodes.tradeoff: Golden datasets must be maintained.

nodes.label: Tracing
nodes.decision: Trace every LLM call with cost and tokens.
nodes.why: Cost and quality become observable per feature.
nodes.tradeoff: Trace volume needs sampling.

adrs.title: Retrieval-augmented, not fine-tuned
adrs.context: Knowledge changes daily; fine-tunes go stale.
adrs.decision: RAG over a versioned index, with citations.
adrs.consequence: Quality depends on chunking and retrieval tuning.

adrs.title: Model gateway with fallback
adrs.decision: Route by capability and cost; fail over automatically.
adrs.consequence: Must keep prompts portable across models.

adrs.title: Evals gate every prompt change
adrs.context: Small prompt edits caused silent regressions.
adrs.decision: Offline eval suite runs in CI; online sampling in prod.
adrs.consequence: Golden datasets become a maintained asset.

context.decision: Draw the boundary before the boxes.
context.why: Agreeing what is in and out of scope prevents most re-architecture later.
context.tradeoff: Some integrations deliberately pushed to v2.

nodes.label: Planner
nodes.decision: Split work into small, testable tasks first.
nodes.why: Small diffs are reviewable and revertible.
nodes.tradeoff: Planning adds a step before any code.

nodes.label: MCP servers
nodes.decision: Tools exposed via MCP, read-only by default.
nodes.why: One protocol for every agent; scoped access.
nodes.tradeoff: Server maintenance per tool.

nodes.label: Coding agents
nodes.decision: Run agents in parallel sandboxes on branches.
nodes.why: Throughput scales with tasks, not people.
nodes.tradeoff: Merge conflicts handled by the planner.

nodes.label: Repository
nodes.decision: Agents never push to main.
nodes.why: Same branch protections as humans.
nodes.tradeoff: Slightly slower path to merge.

nodes.label: Review agent
nodes.decision: AI review before human review.
nodes.why: Humans spend time on design, not nits.
nodes.tradeoff: False positives need tuning.

nodes.label: CI gates
nodes.decision: Identical gates for agent and human code.
nodes.why: Quality bar is enforced, not trusted.
nodes.tradeoff: CI minutes scale with agent output.

adrs.title: Agents propose, humans approve
adrs.context: Autonomy without accountability is a liability.
adrs.decision: Every agent PR requires a named human approver.
adrs.consequence: Review capacity becomes the constraint to manage.

adrs.title: MCP for tool access
adrs.context: Bespoke plugins per agent did not scale.
adrs.decision: Standardise on MCP servers with scoped tokens.
adrs.consequence: Tools are reusable across Claude Code, Codex and others.

adrs.title: Same CI for agents and humans
adrs.consequence: Trust in agent output grows on evidence.

agents.title: My agent [fleet].
agents.intro: I set intent and constraints. Agents plan, write and test in parallel. Guardrails — not vibes — decide what ships.

labels.principlesBody: Agents propose · humans approve · CI is the same for everyone · every run is traced and evaluated.

nodes.label: You
nodes.role: Sets intent, constraints and the definition of done. Reviews the design, not every line.

nodes.label: Planner
nodes.role: Breaks an issue into small, testable tasks and assigns them.
nodes.guard: Task size capped; each task ships with acceptance tests.

nodes.label: Claude Code
nodes.role: Owns larger features and refactors across files in a branch.
nodes.guard: Sandboxed; no direct push; scoped repo token.

nodes.label: Codex
nodes.role: Runs background tasks in parallel — tests, migrations, docs.
nodes.guard: Each task isolated in its own environment.

nodes.label: Copilot
nodes.role: Inline completion while I hand-write the hard, novel parts.
nodes.guard: Human-authored; same review as any code.

nodes.label: Autonomous agent
nodes.role: Picks up well-scoped tickets end-to-end, overnight.
nodes.guard: Only labelled tickets; time and cost budget per run.

nodes.label: MCP servers
nodes.role: Exposes repo, docs, schema and tickets as tools to every agent.
nodes.guard: Read-only by default; write scopes granted per task.

nodes.label: Review
nodes.role: Static analysis, eval suites and an AI reviewer before any human looks.
nodes.guard: Blocks on failed evals, secrets or licence issues.

nodes.label: CI gates
nodes.role: The same gates human code passes. No exceptions.

nodes.label: Merged
nodes.role: Ships behind a feature flag and is observed in production.
